text: Airbus shares fell up to 10% after identifying a new industrial quality issue affecting fuselage panels on dozens of A320 aircraft. This follows a massive weekend disruption caused by a software glitch tied to solar flare interference, grounding much of the A320 fleet and spilling across global travel networks.

meta.note: Mirrors 10/17 Boeing “Clearance Granted” signal → meaningful inversion: October = ascent; December = exposure of flawed ascent systems.
